name: com.drinksystem
description: Networked soda fountain for VRChat worlds (PC + Quest). Cups lock into the machine when you set them down, push-button UI with laser and VR finger presses, pour / fizz / slurp sounds, mixable drinks, drinking with optional screen effects, and cup respawning. Lightweight manual sync. One-click builder: Tools > Drink System > Build Drink Machine In Scene.
